overview.description: The Polen 5Perspectives Large Growth ETF (PCLC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively managed large-cap growth ETF that invests in companies with attractive growth characteristics, competitive advantages, and favorable thematic or business conditions. PCLC was launched on May 18, 2026 and is issued by Polen.
